title: Evaluation of the layered circuit
statement: Let $c$ be a Boolean circuit on $n$ variables and let $x : \mathrm{Fin}\,n \to \bbf_2$ be an input assignment. Evaluating the layered circuit associated to $c$ on the input obtained by mapping each Boolean value into $\mathrm{Fin}\,2$ gives the value of $c$ on $x$, mapped into $\mathrm{Fin}\,2$.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean circuit c on n variables
An assignment x from Fin n to Bool
